description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named ScreenOrientation that presents a Spinner UI element allowing the user to select different screen orientation modes. When a selection is made, it sets the activity's requested orientation accordingly.

classes.name: ScreenOrientation
classes.description: An Android Activity that allows users to select different screen orientations via a Spinner widget.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the Spinner with orientation options, and defines the behavior when a new orientation is selected.
